name: UGC National Eligibility Test
summary: The test for Junior Research Fellowship and eligibility for Assistant Professor in universities and colleges, in 87 subjects. Held twice a year. Two papers in one 3-hour sitting, no negative marking.

status.note: December 2026 session: applications 8 to 28 October 2026 (late fee to 31 October), exam from 14 December 2026.

posts.name: JRF, Assistant Professor eligibility or PhD admission
posts.responsibilities: JRF gives a research fellowship; Assistant Professor eligibility lets you apply for college and university posts.

relaxations.category: OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwBD, third gender, women (JRF)

age.summary: JRF: not more than 30 on the first day of the exam month (1 December 2026), with 5 years relaxation for OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwBD, third gender and women. No upper age limit for Assistant Professor eligibility.

education.summary: A master's degree or equivalent with at least 55% (50% for OBC-NCL, SC, ST, PwBD and third gender). Final-year master's students may apply.

eligibility.examVsPost: NET is eligibility. A job needs a separate college or university recruitment.
eligibility.reservation: Central reservation: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC (non-creamy layer) 27%, EWS 10%, plus horizontal reservation for PwBD and ex-servicemen as per rules.

eligibilityRules.notes: JRF closes at 30 (plus relaxation); no age limit for Assistant Professor eligibility.

stages.name: Computer-based test (Paper 1 and Paper 2)
stages.notes: No negative marking. No break between the papers.

selection.meritCalculation: Assistant Professor eligibility goes to the top 6% of those who appeared, among candidates with at least 40% aggregate (35% reserved), split by subject and category. JRF is a smaller slice from the same ranking.
selection.languages: English and Hindi (language subjects in that language).

sections.subject: Chosen subject (87 options)
topics: Master's-level syllabus of the chosen subject

salary.notes: No salary for the test itself. JRF gives a monthly fellowship as notified by UGC.

progression.timeline: After a college or university recruitment

difficulty.rationale: Only about 6% of those who appear qualify for Assistant Professor eligibility.

ratings.rationale: Held twice a year; opens academic careers.

factors.note: Academic posts depend on separate recruitments.

dataQuality.notes: Dates, pattern, eligibility and qualifying rules from the official NTA bulletin.
